acknowledgement.title: Before your first upload
acknowledgement.readPolicy: Read the Video and Recording Policy

adult.intro: Please confirm each point. ScoutX keeps a record of this acknowledgement.
adult.recordedOrPermission: I recorded the footage myself or have permission from whoever did, and recording was allowed at the venue.
adult.peopleKnow: People who can be clearly identified know about the footage, or I will keep it private.
adult.otherMinors: Children in my videos are only shared with their parents' or guardians' permission.
adult.noPrivatePlaces: My videos don't show changing rooms, private places or personal details like addresses.
adult.privateByDefault: Uploads stay private until I choose to share them, and anyone in a video can ask for it to be removed.

youth.intro: Read each point carefully. If you're unsure, ask your parent, guardian or coach before uploading.
youth.recordedOrPermission: I filmed this myself, or the person who filmed it said I can use it.
youth.peopleKnow: I won't share videos of other people unless they're OK with it.
youth.otherMinors: I won't share videos showing other children without their parents' permission.
youth.noPrivatePlaces: I'll never upload videos from changing rooms or that show where someone lives.
youth.privateByDefault: My uploads stay private. Only I decide what to share, and only if my guardian allows it.

publish.confirmPeople: Everyone clearly identifiable in it agreed, or I have their guardian's consent for children.
publish.confirmPeopleYouth: Everyone in it is OK with it being shared, and no other child appears without permission.
